notes_for_editor: Thin record: two listing-level sources only. Two WebSearches found no history source. The 2019 Pine Lodge Fire and a Pine Lodge Road (NM 246) appear in search and fire updates, but none mention a lookout, so they are not used. A Forest Service decision notice found in search (fs.usda.gov/media/94636) describes two recreation residences named Pine Lodge and Eagle on the Smokey Bear Ranger District. It could not be read through fetch_text, and a Browser pane visit to that link triggered a file save dialog, which was not followed. The notice may show that Pine Lodge is a recreation residence rather than a lookout, so the record's lookout label should be checked against it. The story is about 75 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence does not support more.
